assets.caption: Fig. B-3 Seal Ring Configuration During Makeup Courtesy of Oteco Equipment Company
assets.description: Two-part engineering illustration of seal ring configuration during makeup. Top diagram (FREE POSITION) shows clamp, hub, and seal ring cross-section before makeup. Bottom diagram (MADE-UP POSITION) shows seal ring rib clamped between hub faces with seal ring lip engaged at clamping surface. Descriptive caption: Rib of the seal ring is clamped between hub faces. Lips of the seal ring engage inner hub surface in an interference fit which deflects the lips to achieve a seal.
